messages:
tara: Heads-up — got a handful of enterprise asks this week around telemetry for the console. They want: per-route cost breakdown, faster error analytics (with trace links), and lightweight tracing hooks for user-facing SDKs. Can we outline a minimal launch surface?
omar: Agree we should scope tightly. Which of those are blockers for the requested SLA/contract?
jia: For initial rollout I recommend: Phase 1 = cost + error dashboard (top 10 routes, per-tenant CSV export), Phase 2 = tracing hooks + trace->error linking, Phase 3 = heatmaps / per-function attribution. Keeps engineering ramp manageable.
kevin: Sampling & ingestion cost is the big unknown. If we turn on full traces for all requests we'll blow the telemetry budget. Need a sampling knob and a prefix cache.
sylvia: From the customer side: they specifically want per-tenant daily exports and an alert when error rate delta > 2x baseline. Also need audit logs for Private installs.
tara: Good call, Kevin. Can we draft acceptance criteria that balance fidelity vs cost? Something we can sign off with CS.
jia: Draft acceptance criteria (proposal):
- Dashboards: show top-10 routes by tokens, calls, and cost; filter by tenant and model; daily export (CSV).
- Error analytics: list of recent errors with sample span id + "open in trace" link; aggregation by error class and route.
- Tracing hooks: SDK-level hook that injects a span id and minimal metadata (route, model, token_count); default sampling 1% with config override.
- Performance gate: enabling tracing must not increase p50 API latency by >5ms and p99 by >25ms.
- Cost gate: estimated telemetry ingestion cost <= 5% of infra telemetry budget at 1% sampling.
- Rollout: canary to 5% customers, with automatic rollback on 2x error rate or >10% traffic error spike.
kevin: Love the measurable gates. For sampling control we should expose a per-tenant sampling override in the Console (admin > telemetry). Also add a global kill-switch.
deploy-bot: Canary rollout snippet:
```
rollout:
  strategy: canary
  initial: 0.05
  metrics:
    - name: error_rate
      threshold: 2.0 # 2x baseline
    - name: latency_p99
      threshold: 1.25 # 25% increase
```
omar: Can we also tie a cost delta preview to Optimize? e.g., if customer flips tracing on to 5% sampling, show estimated monthly telemetry cost increase and token cost delta (if we store spans). That will help sales.
sylvia: CS confirms customers will accept phased approach if Phase 1 delivers exports + error links. They pushed target: first demo for the largest customer in ~6 weeks.
tara: Owners?
kevin: I'll own tracing hooks engineering + perf validation. ETA: 4 weeks for SDK hooks + internal tests.
jia: I'll own dashboards + export flows. ETA: 3 weeks for MVP dashboard (top-10 views) then 2 more weeks for export + filtering.
kevin: Need infra help for retention and storage cost calc — https://go/infra-telemetry-cost (placeholder).
omar: Product asks: add two launch criteria to roadmap ticket JIRA-7890: (a) dashboard passes user acceptance with CS signoff, (b) rollback safe and toggleable within 5 minutes.
customer-success: Customers will take the demo. Asking for "open trace" flow to jump straight to span in their APM — can we include a short path? :eyes: :rocket:
tara: For the trace link UX, proposal: trace link opens Console trace viewer filtered by span id, with a permalinking format: `/traces?span_id=<SPAN>&tenant=<TID>`. Keep the link ephemeral for 24h.
jia: UX note: show a small "why this matters" tooltip in the dashboard explaining sampling and expected coverage. Prevents CS confusion.
kevin: One more: put a default retention for tracing metadata of 7 days in hosted. Private should be configurable. That keeps storage bounded.
sylvia: Can we add an enterprise checkbox for "per-tenant export" in Phase 1 so CS can toggle it on for early adopters?
tara: Yes. Add to JIRA-7890 checklist: "per-tenant export toggle".
omar: Summary next steps: owners + PRD stub by EOD, infra estimate by Tuesday, customer demo target locked for 6 weeks. If we miss perf gates, we pivot to lower sampling and richer error aggregation instead.
jia: I'll put up a PRD stub and a mock dashboard screenshot in Figma.
kevin: I'll run a small perf test on dev with 1% sampling to get telemetry QPS numbers.
customer-success: I'll build the demo script and coordinate with the customer for a date window.
tara: Great — thanks everyone. Next sync in 3 days to finalize gates. :white_check_mark:
